name: Chapter Route - London Event Photos
description: London's own gallery, built from the three photos Nicole uploaded through /admin on 21 Oct: the evening reception under the crystal ceiling and two shots of the London co-working day. They are the real content entries, not a seed, so this is exactly what a visitor sees. The duplicate copies and her layout mockup that came in with the same uploads are gone, so the gallery shows three tiles and nothing else.
